name: UnlinkAccount
description: Remove a member address from the sender's account group, or leave it. It takes nothing with it.

params.name: sender_privkey
params.help: the signing key: 32-byte Ed25519 seed as 64 hex; '-' or omitted = ZBC_KEY

params.name: member
params.help: the address leaving the group (your own to leave; any member if you are the controller)

notes: Rule account_groups: accepted from its activation height.
